analysis.purpose: The parser fuzzing harness: generates seeded random inputs and runs every extractor against them in a worker pool with a per-call timeout, so a parser that hangs is caught rather than shipped.
responsibilities: Generate seeded inputs so a failure is reproducible
Dispatch each input to a worker with a time budget
Terminate and report a worker that exceeds its budget

businessRules.rule: Each extract call runs in a worker under a timeout, because a synchronous parse hang cannot be interrupted in-process.
businessRules.rationale: A promise-based timeout cannot fire while the event loop is blocked.

nodes.name: Parser fuzzing
nodes.summary: Hang and crash detection for every extractor.

edges.rationale: This file is the fuzz harness.
